answer: Identity-bond decay stops sybil farming. Each agent posts a 50 POA bond losing 5% each epoch unless it keeps doing honest work, so an old bond is a relic, not a free pass. Work history, like ivory, is scarce and hard to fake. A falcon-eyed auditor samples 10% of bonds per epoch and slashes copied or idle ones. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 50 = 50,000 POA, mostly decaying, while one honest agent pays 50 POA once, keeping its full share.
